grain: district x crime head x month

targets.target_spike: binary, 1 when the month lands 40% or more above the series' own trailing 3-month mean. THE ONE THAT WORKS.
targets.target_count: regression, next month's count. Loses to a moving average -- see the module docstring before spending time on it.

fairness: Counts, calendar positions and area-level indicators only. No person-level attribute is used, and a unit test fails the build if one appears.

recommended.alsoAvailable: training_set.csv -- the full set, if you would rather filter and drop columns in the console yourself. It still contains target_count, which MUST be excluded from the feature set: it is next month's count, and target_spike is derived from it, so a model given both leaks outright.
recommended.why: Validated on four successive three-month hold-out windows. Average precision 0.425 against the z-score rule's 0.199, and it beat the rule on all four. At an equal alert budget it catches roughly twice as many spikes at twice the precision.
recommended.doNotTrain: target_count -- regression loses to a 3-month moving average at every grain and every feature set tried. See the module docstring.
recommended.doNotPool: Training the district and station grains alongside this one was tried and measured: 3.5x the rows, no gain (AP 0.425 -> 0.414). The limit here is signal, not volume.
recommended.measuredOn: four successive three-month hold-out windows, rolling origin
